moat_against: No commercial revenue base — FY2026 revenue $8.26M after the Dermavant sale; no proven pricing power
Value concentrated in three clinical assets with binary trial/regulatory risk
IMVT-1402 faces entrenched FcRn competition (argenx Vyvgart, J&J nipocalimab); brepocitinib carries JAK boxed-warning overhang
Heavy SBC load ($346.2M FY2026) on top of ~$750-816M/yr negative operating cash flow
Monetization history is one-off asset sales and litigation, not recurring owner's earnings
moat_for: Vant model has repeatedly in-licensed, developed and monetized assets (Telavant to Roche, Dermavant to Organon)
Genevant foundational LNP patent estate produced a $2.25B Moderna settlement, $950M paid July 2026
Three late-stage pipeline-in-a-product assets: brepocitinib/Lisraya, IMVT-1402, mosliciguat
Company-reported $4.3B cash and marketable securities at FY2026 funds the pipeline and buybacks
moat_justification: The Vant sourcing/development model and the Genevant LNP patent estate have repeatedly converted into cash (Telavant sold to Roche in 2023, Dermavant to Organon in 2024, a $2.25B Moderna settlement), which is a real organizational capability — but Roivant owns no commercial product with proven pricing power yet, its revenue base was sold with Dermavant, and pipeline value is concentrated in three binary assets facing entrenched competition. A proven deal machine is not yet a durable earnings moat — weak, 4/10.
name: Roivant Sciences Ltd.
one_liner: Proven deal-making platform, moat 4/10, with a large cash pile and three late-stage assets — but conservative OE is negative on the median (-$1.56/share), latest-FY (-$1.59/share) and TTM (-$1.62/share) bases, so Tier F on this screen and no 15%-clearing price is computable from an OE DCF.
